propositions: Production in-process verifier (Arm A) achieved 100% agreement with ground truth on 65 AC judgments with zero false-PASS and zero false-FAIL verdicts on real ACs.
Minimal free-tool harness agent (Arm B) achieved 94.6% agreement with 5 false-FAIL verdicts on real epic ACs, concentrated on strict-literal readings of AC7 and AC2 clauses.
Arm A median wall time was 131 seconds versus Arm B median of 415.5 seconds, making Arm B ~3.2× slower despite using uncapped local execution.
Arm B produced zero INSUFFICIENT verdicts by discovering in-tree tickets branches for externally-referenced criteria, contrary to the hypothesis of insufficiency-loop pain.
The predeclared GO rule required Arm B rejections strictly less than Arm A (5 < 0 FALSE) and wall time ≤ 2× Arm A (415.5 ≤ 262 FALSE), both failing, resulting in NO-GO decision.
Arm A cumulative Bedrock spend was $12.82 of the $20 cap with 9 total runs; Arm B remained free with 12 runs and zero harness errors or retries.
